title: Feasibility of an Implementation Strategy for a Physical Activity Program in Rural Middle Schools
official: Feasibility of a Multilevel Implementation Strategy for a Sport-based Youth Development Physical Activity Program in Rural Middle Schools
summary: The investigators aim to build on the pilot study data looking at the feasibility of implementation of Goal Setting alongside Hoosier Sport at two schools (Eastern Greene Middle School and White River Valley Middle School). The investigators plan to assess the effect of goal setting on physical activity engagement and psychological measures across the two schools. One school will receive the goal setting intervention in Fall while the other will receive it in Spring.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Currently enrolled in 6th - 7th grade at White River Valley Middle School or Eastern Greene Middle School
* Have parental consent to participate
* Agree to study participation \[verbal assent\]
* Planning to attend all school days during the program period
* Be available for baseline and post-intervention measurement.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a medical condition that would interfere with the goal-setting program plan
* In treatment for a psychiatric disorder such that the intervention materials will not be appropriate.
